prompts.product:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create a publication-quality AIGC product architecture infographic for a Chinese WeChat learning article about the open source LearnBuddy project. The input image is a CONTENT REFERENCE only, not a style to copy. Improve it into a beautifully organized, highly informative editorial architecture map. Portrait 2:3, highest available native resolution; request 2048x3072 if possible. Crisp readable simplified Chinese typography is the first priority, generous minimum text size, clean flat vector-like finish, warm off-white paper, deep teal #2c6e6a and restrained amber. No fake photo, no robots, no decorative buildings, no art-only scenery, no glows, no blur, no tiny footnotes, no invented features. Less than 15% purely decorative space. Smart aligned layers, subtle precise line icons per layer, meaningful connectors, strong hierarchy.
Exact content to preserve, may break into shorter lines but never paraphrase words or add labels:
Title "LearnBuddy 产品架构"
Subtitle "从学习目标，到持续行动"
Four visibly distinct horizontal layers, stacked TOP to BOTTOM, with large clear Chinese labels:
"用户体验" : "定目标 → 测基础 → 学练 → 复盘"
"前端与渠道" : "目标对话" "学习空间" "路径与课程" "画像与自检" ; special amber outlined smaller node "个人飞书 · 可选"
"学习服务" : "评估与生成" "教学与练习" "复习与推荐" "分析与重规划"
"领域实体" : "学习者 / 目标" "评估证据 / 画像" "路径 / 任务" "记录 / 掌握度"
A visible side feedback arrow connecting learning practice back toward learning services labeled "学习反馈".
Below these layers, a clean pair of edition panels:
"Cloud · 公有云体验" : "平台模型 · 有限额度" "多用户隔离"
"Personal · 个人拥有" : "单 owner · 自备 Key" "自有数据 · 可选飞书"
Footer prominent single line: "共享代码与能力，各自数据独立"
A second small but readable footer: "真实飞书与新版生产仍待验收"
Invariants: the two editions are cross-cutting deployment choices, not separate sequential workflow steps. Personal Feishu must not be visually presented as a Cloud feature. No claims of production readiness. Labels must be legible as an article image on mobile. Visual sophistication through diagram organization and hierarchy, not ornamental content.
prompts.system:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Generate an elegant, technically correct AIGC system architecture infographic for a Chinese WeChat practical guide to LearnBuddy. The input diagram is a CONTENT REFERENCE; redesign visual presentation, not system responsibilities. Portrait 2:3, highest available native resolution; request 2048x3072 if possible. Crisp simplified Chinese type, near-flat vector illustration finish, warm ivory, deep teal and restrained amber. Diagram fills canvas intelligently. No photorealism, robots, floating abstract tech, huge whitespace, tiny typography, decorative architecture, fake logos or invented systems.
Exact title: "LearnBuddy 系统与 Agent"
Subtitle: "两个入口，一套学习领域服务"
Top row has two distinct lanes:
Left box "Web 前端" with secondary "学习空间 / 路径 / 学练"; down arrow labeled "HTTP / SSE" to box "FastAPI".
Right box "个人飞书" with secondary "仅 Personal 可选"; down arrow to box "OpenClaw" with secondary "会话 / 上下文 / 工具编排"; next arrow labeled "受限 MCP".
Both lanes JOIN the same wide authorization/control boundary band "身份 · 归属 · 参数 · 额度".
Below that a large central core labeled "LearnBuddy Core", containing 4 compact readable groups "评估 / 画像" "路径 / 学练" "记忆 / 复习" "推荐 / 重规划".
Core connects by clear bilateral read/write connector to storage box "SQLite + JSON" with secondary "学习事实与记录". Core connects by separate request/response connector to model box "模型 API" with secondary "生成与辅助判断". Model API must NOT be placed inside storage and must never have arrow granting permissions.
At bottom a separate reminder lane clearly labeled "主动提醒 · 独立调度": "提醒规则 → 调度器 → 队列 → 飞书". Connect Core/storage to this reminder lane as appropriate. This does not pass through the OpenClaw conversation loop. Do not create duplicate senders.
Footer clear and readable: "Agent 调工具，不直接改数据库"
Footer second line: "Cloud 不接个人飞书；真实渠道仍待验收"
Arrows should make real request flow obvious; do not draw misleading data sync between different deployments. Use controlled borders, slight depth and readable layer accents. Show actual architecture structure, never just stack paragraphs into cards. All quoted Chinese strings must be exact.

note: Requested high native resolution, verify actual outputs; no raster upscaling.

targeted_edits.name: product
targeted_edits.prompt: Make ONE precise correction to this diagram, preserving all typography, Chinese text, layout, icons, colors, aspect ratio and other connectors unchanged. REMOVE ONLY the short horizontal dashed double-headed arrow in the gap between the bottom Cloud and Personal boxes (at roughly x=468..548, y=1285 on the 1024x1536 image). Fill that short arrow area with the matching light paper background. Those two editions do not synchronize data. KEEP the thin branching dashed bracket ABOVE these boxes, and keep all other parts unchanged. No new text, no new connectors. Maintain native resolution and crisp text.

targeted_edits.name: system
targeted_edits.prompt: Make ONE precise architectural correction, preserving all text, layout, icons, colors, aspect ratio and remaining connectors unchanged. The model API box at the right (模型 API, around x=744..978,y=898..1036) must ONLY connect to LearnBuddy Core through the two orange request/response arrows. REMOVE the green connector that exits from the BOTTOM of the 模型 API box, travels down to around y=1088 and then left to the central junction above the 主动提醒 band. Cleanly fill the deleted right-hand connector with matching paper background. KEEP the independent green connector from the bottom of LearnBuddy Core at x=305 down and right to x=511, and its downward arrow into 主动提醒. Thus ONLY Core has the green line into reminder scheduling. Do not change the orange request/response arrows or the read/write SQLite connector. No added connectors or text. Keep all typography crisp and preserve the entire rest of the diagram.
